quote.text: God has entrusted me with myself. No man is free who is not master of himself. A man should so live that his happiness shall depend as little as possible on external things. The world turns aside to let any man pass who knows where he is going.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Embrace the teaching that each of us is responsible for shaping our own character — as a parent, lead by example and cultivate self-mastery not only for yourself but for your children, nurturing resilience and independent thought.
  • Parenthood: Recognize that true freedom and happiness come from within. Guide your children to value internal virtues over external approvals, encouraging them to seek fulfillment in experiences, character strength, and inner peace.
  • Leadership: A leader must be the architect of his own mind, much like the idea that “no man is free who is not master of himself.” Develop self-discipline and clarity of purpose to inspire others and steer organizational destiny.
  • Leadership: Understand that external circumstances are not the foundation of lasting success. Cultivate an inner compass and a clear vision, allowing your inherent values to guide decisions, fostering a culture that values self-reliance and integrity.
  • Product Management: Just as the world turns aside for the determined, a product manager with a clear vision and self-mastery navigates challenges effortlessly. Prioritize aligning the product’s core value with the deep insights of customer needs rather than temporary external trends.
  • Product Management: Ensure that your strategies are built on internal strength — rigorous self-reflection, accountability, and continuous improvement. Balance external market feedback with internally driven innovation to keep your product mission authentic and resilient.
